newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-ANZ signs up Internet bank developer.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-ANZ signs up Internet bank developer.

text.p: Australia and New Zealand Banking Group Ltd said on Monday it had signed an agreement with U.S.-based Internet banking specialist Security First Network Bank to develop its own Internet banking service.

ANZ's Internet service, called PC Banking, will initially allow customers to check account balances, transfer funds between accounts, pay bills, review past transactions and transaction management, ANZ said in a statement.
An ANZ spokeswoman declined to give details of the agreement with Security First.
ANZ said it planned to offer PC Banking to its customers by mid-1997.
Security First operates an Internet bank which allows 24-hour a day banking in cyberspace from any personal computer with World Wide Web browser software.
